newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SAUDI RAS TANURA REFINERY DOWN FROM AUG 20 - MEES.
newsitem.headline: SAUDI RAS TANURA REFINERY DOWN FROM AUG 20 - MEES.

text.p: A 30-day maintenance shutdown has been scheduled starting August 20 at Saudi Aramco's 265,000 barrels per day (bpd) Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.

It said the maintenance work "has released extra supplies of Arab Light and Extra Light (crude) for export in August and September. The plant's sole distillation tower is expected to be shut down for 30 days beginning August 20. That should free up an average of 100,000 bpd in August and 200,000 bpd in September."

"While Aramco initially tried to place the re-routed Ras Tanura volumes with higher-paying Asian customers, most ended up with refiners in the West during August and this pattern is likely to be repeated in September," MEES added.
Gulf traders had told Reuters that during the maintenance work reforming units will stay up to ensure gasoline supplies.
A $1.5 billion upgrading and expansion programme at the Gulf plant is expected to be commissioned in June 1998, boosting capacity to 300,000 bpd and raising middle distillate and gasoline yields.
